en: A sepia-toned historic postcard view of an industrial complex and surrounding town. The scene shows multiple factory buildings with tall smokestacks, smaller residential or administrative buildings in the foreground, and a hilly, mined-looking landscape behind. There is a central open square or yard with a gate, trees, fences, and a horse-drawn vehicle near the entrance. The title text is printed at the top in red, with additional small red text and a number at the bottom.
